newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities market closed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities market closed.

text.p: The Singapore government securities market was closed on Friday for a holiday. The market will reopen on Monday, March 31.

On Thursday, July 1998 bonds closed at S$99.20/99.30 compared with Wednesday's close of S$99.33/99.38, September 2001 at S$97.13/97.18 against S$97.38/97.43 and June 2003 at 95.13/95.18 from S$95.38/95.43.
The overnight interbank offered rate rose to 3-15/16 3-13/16 percent versus Wednesday's 3-1/2 3-3/8 percent.
In treasury bills, three-months ended at a yield of 1.05/1.00 percent against Wednesday's yield of 0.75/0.70 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.55/1.50 percent from 1.43/1.38 percent.
